diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says EN, datasheet reading says ENABLE
diffs.evidence: Pololu #2990 board photo (https://a.pololu-files.com/picture/0J5751.600x480.jpg): the silkscreen on this pad (left row, 3rd pin, below VCC) reads 'EN'. Silkscreen layout: '-GND-', 'VIN VCC', 'O2 EN', 'O1 PH', 'VM SLP'. Pololu's annotated pinout graphic (https://a.pololu-files.com/picture/0J5752.1200.jpg), which the second reading used, labels the same pad 'ENABLE'. The product page uses the long names too: 'OUT1 H-bridge output 1. OUT2 H-bridge output 2. PHASE ... Direction control input. ENABLE ... Speed control input'. Both readings name the same pin in the same position. The model uses the printed silkscreen name and spells out the long name in the pin description.
